definition: the middle part of an area
description: In the sandy arena of a huge ancient stone amphitheatre, with rows of golden arches and stone seats curving all around under a pale blue sky with thin clouds, a young woman with curly dark hair, in a mustard blouse, a flowing white skirt and sandals, spins round and round with her arms out, laughing, her skirt swirling. She stays right in the middle of the empty arena, inside a large circle drawn in the sand, and small birds fly high above the walls.

de.answer: Sie dreht sich in der Mitte um sich selbst.
phrases: sich immer wieder um sich selbst drehen
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está dando vueltas en el centro.
phrases: volar por encima de los muros
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle tourne sur elle-même au centre.
phrases: tourner sur elle-même encore et encore
fr.question: Que fait la femme ?
